name: Japanese-style Room

basicInfo.label: Bed / Futon
basicInfo.value: Futon (prepared based on number of guests)

basicInfo.label: View
basicInfo.value: Lake Toya view / angled lake view

description: A relaxing Japanese-style room. Unwind surrounded by the warmth of tatami and views of Lake Toya.
Choose from the first floor or higher floors, based on your budget and preferred view.
*Interior photos are for illustration only and may differ from the actual room.

floors.label: 1st Floor Room
floors.reservationName: [1F] Japanese-style room facing the lake, 8 tatami mats
description: A first-floor room facing the lake, offered at a more affordable rate than upper-floor rooms.
As it is on the first floor, the view and long-run fireworks may be somewhat obstructed. Thank you for your understanding.

floors.label: 2nd Floor & Above
floors.reservationName: Japanese-style room facing the lake, 8 tatami mats
badges: View of Nakajima Island & Mt. Yotei
description: Our standard Japanese-style room, on the 2nd floor or above, with views of Lake Toya, Nakajima Island, and Mt. Yotei.
You can also enjoy the Lake Toya Long-Run Fireworks Festival (held late April to late October) at your leisure from your room.

floors.label: 2nd Floor Room (with Desk)
floors.reservationName: [With Desk] Japanese-style room facing the lake, 8 tatami mats
badges: View of Nakajima Island & Mt. Yotei
description: A Japanese-style room with a desk by the window, so you can work comfortably with a lake view.
Recommended for workation, remote work, reading, or similar uses.

floors.label: Window-side Lake-view Japanese-style Room
description: A room positioned at an angle to the lake, with a lake view from the window.
Enjoy the Long-Run Fireworks Festival from a different angle than the front-facing lake-view rooms.
